title: Document RAG QA Assistant
description: Enterprise Hybrid RAG engine combining Dense Gemini embeddings with Sparse TF-IDF lexical search via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF). Features conversational memory rewriting, automated grounding faithfulness guardrails, and full Dockerized deployment.

title: Customer Segmentation & Sentiment Analysis

title: Sales Analytics & Forecasting Dashboard
description: Executive sales intelligence platform featuring automated SARIMAX (p,d,q)x(P,D,Q)s AIC grid-search optimization, Ljung-Box residual diagnostics, cohort survival matrices, and predictive Customer Lifetime Value (LTV) modeling.
